Method of Attack: Ransomware with infostealer features that can dump browser passwords from Internet Explorer, Google Chrome, and Mozilla Firefox
Steals files related to Bitcoin wallets such as wallet.dat, *.wallet, and electrum.dat
Collects and steals data from victim's computer similar to an infostealer
Impacted Systems: Browsers: Internet Explorer, Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox
Bitcoin wallet apps: Bitcoin Core (wallet.dat), Multibit (*.wallet), Electrum (electrum.dat)
